Figure 6.3: Document Upload Interface
6.5
Chunk Generation Result
After extraction, documents are divided into smaller chunks.
The implemented chunking strategies preserve semantic information while maintaining
efficient retrieval performance.
The generated chunks are stored along with metadata including:
• Document ID
• Page Number
• Chunk ID
• Chunk Index
6.6
Embedding Generation Result
Each generated chunk is converted into a 384-dimensional embedding vector using the
Sentence Transformer model.
The embedding process enables semantic similarity search instead of keyword match-
ing.
Normalized embeddings improve cosine similarity calculations during retrieval.
